ROLE:
Lead CATO Engineer Location: Mumbai/Bangalore
The role focuses on enabling Zero Trust Network Access, replacing traditional VPN architectures, and ensuring secure, optimized connectivity for users and applications. Key Responsibilities
1. ZTNA Implementation & Management • Deploy and configure Cato ZTNA solutions for secure remote and branch access • Replace legacy VPN solutions with Zero Trust architecture • Configure identity-based access policies for users, devices, and applications • Implement client-based and clientless ZTNA access
2. Cato SASE Platform Administration • Manage Cato Management Application (CMA) • Configure and maintain: o SD-WAN policies o Security policies (FWaa S, IPS, CASB, SWG) o Traffic steering and network segmentation • Monitor network performance across global Po Ps
3. Security & Access Control • Integrate with Identity Providers (Id P) such as: o Azure AD / Entra ID o Okta o ADFS • Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) • Enforce least privilege access policies
4. Troubleshooting & Support • Diagnose issues related to: o User access failures o Tunnel connectivity o Application access via ZTNA • Perform packet analysis and traffic inspection • Provide L2/L3 support for production issues
5. Network & Connectivity • Configure and manage: o IPsec tunnels o Cato Socket deployments (physical/virtual) o Remote user clients (Windows, mac OS, mobile) • Optimize application performance using WAN optimization
6. Monitoring & Reporting • Use Cato dashboards for: o Traffic analysis o Security events o User activity monitoring • Generate regular reports for compliance and management
7. Documentation & Compliance • Create and maintain: o Network diagrams o Standard operating procedures (SOPs) o Configuration documents • Support audits and compliance requirements Technical Skills • Strong experience with: o Cato Networks SASE platform (mandatory/preferred) o Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts o SD-WAN technologies • Knowledge of networking fundamentals: o TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP o Routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) • Experience with: o Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco) o VPN technologies (IPsec, SSL VPN) • Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) Security Skills • Understanding of: o Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) o Identity & Access Management (IAM) o Secure Web Gateway (SWG) o CASB and DLP concepts Tools & Technologies • Cato Management Application • Wireshark / packet capture tools • SIEM tools (Splunk, Sentinel – nice to have) • Endpoint security integrations Candidate should be open 24/7 Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA.
